race.description: Iron Horse Equine Nutrition Antoxiflam Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BANFFSHIRE (5) sets the standard off a much sharper Bunbury fifth, where he was beaten two and a half lengths after covering ground and finishing strongly at long odds. The first attempt at around 1720m is the query, but he is race fit and that latest effort is the most convincing recent form in this line-up. CABRERA (7) has not fired this campaign, yet she was slow to begin at York and has already placed from her only start at this track, which keeps her firmly in the mix. MOMOTARO (9) brings a genuine excuse from Belmont Park after being steadied near the 900m and had beaten CABRERA at Northam the run prior, so she could be a threat if the breaks come. WALLENBERG (3) improved to fifth at York, despite racing keenly and laying in, and that makes him a sound place hope in a modest maiden.
